_about: SK-3174 plan 752 v1, the rows that went wrong, sanitized for this public repo: host is mcp.example.test, tool names generic, no tokens. Line numbers point at the fixture's repo/ files.

happy_path.title: A member lists their files through POST /mcp
steps: Send POST https://mcp.example.test/mcp with tools/call files_search {"pageSize":3}.
happy_path.expected: HTTP 200 with a table headed Name, File ID.
happy_path.credentials: Bearer token for test user A (files.read), minted through the connector sign-in
happy_path.how_to_verify: Checked from outside (HTTP response): result text.

security_negative_tests.title: POST /mcp tools/call with no Authorization header
steps: Send the request with no Authorization header.
Record the status, WWW-Authenticate header and body.
security_negative_tests.expected: HTTP 401, WWW-Authenticate error="invalid_token", error_description "A bearer token is required."
security_negative_tests.how_to_verify: Checked from outside (HTTP response): curl -i output.

regression_checklist: 🔴 Files search — at risk via server/src/files/search.ts. Steps: 1. As user A, tools/call files_search {"pageSize":3}. Expected: HTTP 200 with a table headed Name, File ID. Check: result text.

🟡 Viewer card in the chat client — at risk via server/src/viewer/stamp.ts. Steps: 1. In the chat client, open a document. 2. Reopen the chat after more than 2 minutes. Expected: the reopened card shows 'Show this document again'. Check: the card.

🟡 Identity provider key outage — at risk via server/src/app.ts. Steps: 1. Only if the platform team can block JWKS for a moment; otherwise skip. Expected: 503 with Retry-After 5 and no WWW-Authenticate. Check: curl -i.
🟡 Batch requests — at risk via server/src/app.ts. Steps: 1. POST /mcp with a JSON array of two tools/call. Expected: 400 JSON-RPC -32600 'Batch requests are not supported.' Check: response.

🟡 Wrong host — at risk via server/src/app.ts. Steps: 1. POST /mcp with Host: evil.example. Expected: 421 {"error":"misdirected_request"}. Check: response (an envoy rejection earlier on is also acceptable; record which layer answered).

environment_topology_v1.in_front: envoy-host → app pod (port 3000) serving mcp.example.test; Fastify route POST /mcp

environment_topology_cdn.in_front: Cloudflare (proxied DNS) → envoy ingress → app pod (port 3000) serving mcp.example.test
